project.title: Architectural Confinement and Seasonal Forcing Shape Cross-Kingdom Pathogen Assemblages in Complex Built Environments Raw sequence reads
project.description: A year-long investigation (September 2023-August 2024) on a university campus in the Yangtze River Delta, serving as a model system for complex public buildings with extensive underground infrastructure.
